title: Accessible hero screens and icon redraw for quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Perform an accessibility-first redesign pass on the Quickstart onboarding hero screens and associated micro-iconography used across docs and the product SDK quickstart. This ticket covers contrast tuning, iconstroke redraw, responsive variants for mobile/tablet/desktop, and dev-ready asset exports.

Background: Current onboarding visuals rely on low-contrast pastel strokes and bitmap screenshots that fail automated a11y checks in dark mode and at small sizes. Engineering has reported flaky contrast when the product UI switches themes, and customers in regulated industries requested stronger accessibility guarantees for onboarding flows.

Scope:
- Update primary hero illustrations (3 variants: full-screen, compact, card) to meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for text and 3:1 non-text contrast for icons and essential graphic elements.
- Redraw 18 quickstart icons (API, Keys, CLI, SDK, Region, Billing, Metrics, Logs, Fallbacks, Config) as single-color SVGs with 16/24/32px grid-aligned strokes and optical adjustments.
- Create theme-aware tokenized color palette samples for light/dark modes and annotate Figma components with token names.
- Produce motion-reduced GIF/MP4 alternatives and static PNG fallbacks for marketing emails and old clients.
- Provide dev implementation notes: currentColor support, accessible <title> tags in SVG, aria-hidden fallback guidance, and export naming convention.

Constraints and trade-offs:
- Maintain visual parity with brand while increasing weight of critical strokes; may require slight visual compensation on decorative elements to avoid heavy appearance.
- Small icons (<=16px) will prioritize glyph clarity over decorative detail to keep contrast and recognizability.
- For extreme contrast requirements in legacy image formats, we will provide a secondary high-contrast PNG set that increases visual weight by 8-12% luminance difference to meet automated tooling.

Deliverables:
- Figma file: updated components and tokenized palette.
- SVG master assets (single-color, optimized, with title/desc).
- PNG fallbacks (1x and 2x) for email and docs.
- Implementation doc (DEV-Ready notes) describing CSS variables, import paths, and a small usage snippet.
- Accessibility audit summary with WCAG ratios per asset.
acceptance_criteria: All hero screen heading and body text meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text where applicable)
All critical icons meet 3:1 non-text contrast against background in both light and dark tokens
SVGs are exported with single fill/stroke using currentColor and include accessible <title> metadata
Figma components use token names matching design system (e.g., --color-on-surface, --color-surface-700) and have variant properties for light/dark/responsive
Dev implementation doc includes example CSS variables and a recommended import path and is linked in the PR
QA checklist completed with screenshots for desktop/tablet/mobile in both themes and a short accessibility audit report attached
comments: 2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Initial audit attached. Ran Axe on current onboarding flows; found 12 failures related to contrast and 6 icons that lose definition at 16px in dark mode. Link to audit in attachments.

2026-03-04 Arjun Patel: Sketches uploaded to Figma. Proposed increasing primary stroke weight from 1px to 1.5px for 24/32px icons and switching to geometric simplification at 16px. Leaving decorative gradients for hero backgrounds but reducing saturation.

2026-03-06 PM review (Lena Ortiz): Aligns with customer ask for stronger contrast. Request: ensure screenshots embedded in hero cards are cropped to show high-contrast UI elements (eg. nav labels) to avoid false negatives in audits.

2026-03-09 Eng feedback (Devops team): Please include explicit guidance for SVG fallbacks for older WebView clients and a minimal JS polyfill suggestion. Also request export naming to include release tag (console-2026.03).
2026-03-11 Design critique: Small icons iteration 2 approved by Design Lead (Priya Rao). Minor adjustment requested: increase inner counter spacing on the 'Keys' icon to improve legibility at 12px.

2026-03-12 QA update: Dark-mode hero screenshots added; automated contrast checks now pass on 10 of 11 core hero variants. Remaining failure is the marketing email header—working on PNG high-contrast fallback.
